decisions.reason: Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support, so the firm can easily interpret customer uptake and refine the offer with knowledge it already holds.

The version management tool builds on the firm's own software development and its management tools that reduce recurring work, so in-house R&D can keep improving it, although website visibility was not observed after 2019.

The GDPR contract tool is distant from the hosting knowledge base, which limits the firm's ability to learn from it and develop it, but it serves a lasting legal need of agency customers and costs little to maintain, so it stays for now at high risk of withdrawal.

Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and sits squarely within its hosting, data center and support expertise, giving it the strongest absorptive capacity to interpret results and keep improving the product.
